newsitem.title: GERMANY: IBM promotes head of German operation.
newsitem.headline: IBM promotes head of German operation.

text.p: IBM's German unit said on Tuesday that its chief executive Edmund Hug would take up a post at the company's regional headquarters in Paris and would be replaced by Hermann-Josef Lamberti.

Hug, 56, has headed IBM Deutschland GmbH since October 1993 and will take over responsibility for the group's stable of nationally-based units in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, IBM said in a statement.

The 40-year-old Lamberti, whose appointment is subject to approval by the supervisory board, joined IBM in 1985 and worked in Paris in 1994 and 1995. Since 1995 he has had global responsibility for marketing IBM's S/390 computer system.
